fields.explore_cta: Build My Boat Rental Waiver Form
fields.features_heading: What the Dock Crew Checks Before the Keys
fields.features_subheading: Six parts of the waiver that put a signed record and a passenger count in front of the dock crew before a boat leaves the slip.
fields.feature_1:
Renters sign from the booking email

Put the waiver link in every booking confirmation. Renters read and sign at home the night before. The dock crew has the record on file before the first car pulls into the lot.
fields.feature_2:
A passenger list on every rental

The renter names each person going aboard, adults and children, with an emergency contact who stays on shore. The dock tablet shows the count beside the renter's signature.
fields.feature_3:
A parent signs for renters under 18

When a date of birth puts a paddler or passenger under 18, a parent section opens. The parent signs in their own name, and both signatures sit on the same rental record.
fields.feature_4:
Operator details before the key

Ask whoever drives the boat for their boater education card number and the state that issued it. Add the rider rules you want initialed, such as the return time and the wake zones.
fields.feature_5:
Dock tablet search by last name

Dock staff type a last name and see the renter's status, the time of signing, and the passenger count. A renter who skipped the email signs at the dock from a QR code on the shed.
fields.feature_6:
Export the code to your GitHub

On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository and run the waiver app beside your booking system. Keep changing it by prompting Emergent, or hand it to a developer.

fields.usecase_heading: How Four Rental Docks Use the Same Waiver
fields.tab_content_1:
Seven life jackets, each for a name on the booking

Ottokar Tullock booked the 24-foot pontoon at Tern Hollow Marina for Saturday. He signs from the booking confirmation at 8:40 AM and lists 7 people aboard. At the slip, dock hand Mirabel Haugland types Tullock into the tablet and sees Signed, 7 aboard. She counts out 7 life jackets before she hands over the key.
fields.tab_content_2:
Ruadhan is 16, which opens a section for his mother

At Bracken Lake Paddle Co, paddlers scan the QR code on the rack to sign. Ruadhan Grebe enters a date of birth that makes him 16, and a parent section opens. His mother, Saoirse Grebe, signs it in her own name on his phone. The rack attendant's tablet marks Ruadhan Signed with a Parent signed tag.
fields.tab_content_3:
The jet ski key waits until a card number is on file

Every jet ski at Rook Harbor Watersports leaves with an operator on record. Leocadia Pelletier types in the number from her boater education card and the issuing state. She then initials 4 rider rules, the last one a 2:00 PM return. The launch tablet shows Card on file beside her name, and the attendant hands her the key.
fields.tab_content_4:
The 10:02 AM waiver reopened when the boat returned

A rental pontoon came back to Copperfin Marina at 4:15 PM with a bent propeller. Manager Kasimir Amsel searches Hollier on the office tablet and opens Wystan Hollier's waiver, signed at 10:02 AM on version 4 of the wording. He writes a damage note on that record, naming the propeller and the return time.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Boat Rental Waiver Form
fields.howto_description: Follow seven steps to set up a boat rental waiver form that every renter signs before taking the keys.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 List every boat and what it needs
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Decide who signs, and at what age
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Get the release read by an attorney
fields.howto_step_1_des: Walk the dock and list every boat you rent, such as pontoons, kayaks, and jet skis. Note what each one needs from the renter: a passenger count for a pontoon, or the operator's card details for a jet ski.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Choose whether every adult aboard signs or the renter signs for the group. Set the age below which a parent signs, and your own minimum age to drive each boat. The form branches on these choices. Settle them before any wording.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Have an attorney licensed in your state read the draft before the first renter sees it. Enforceability depends on how a waiver is written and on the laws of your state. Some states limit waivers for minors. Point the attorney to the parent section by name.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Write one prompt that names your boats, the passenger list, the parent rule, and what the dock tablet shows. Emergent builds the waiver, a database of signed copies, and the dock screen. Ask for changes the same way, in plain English.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Send the link with every booking
fields.howto_step_5_des: Paste the waiver link into the booking confirmation email, and renters sign the night before. Print a QR code for the rental shed for walk-ups. Keep each clause short enough to read on a phone in bright sun on the dock.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Test it with your dock crew
fields.howto_step_6_des: Have 4 staff members sign as renters before opening weekend: one with a full pontoon, one under 18 with a parent, one on a jet ski, and one who skips the email. Check each record on the dock tablet.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Keep every version of the wording
fields.howto_step_7_des: When the wording changes, save it as a new version and keep each signature tied to the version its signer read. Ask your attorney or insurer how long to keep records, and keep them searchable by last name.

faq_plan.q: What is a boat rental waiver form?
faq_plan.a: A boat rental waiver form is a liability waiver a renter signs before taking a boat out. A liability waiver is a legal document in which a participant acknowledges the risks of an activity and agrees not to hold the organizing party responsible if an injury or incident occurs. This one also records the boat, the rental day, and everyone aboard.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a boat rental waiver form?
faq_plan.a: List your boats and age rules, get the release reviewed by a lawyer who practices where you operate, then describe the form in one prompt to Emergent's AI form builder. Emergent builds the waiver and a database for every signed copy, and you change either one by prompting.

faq_plan.q: Which renter and boat details should a boat rental waiver form collect?
faq_plan.a: Collect the renter's name, date of birth, phone number, and a shore contact to call in an emergency. Ask which boat they booked and the names of every passenger, then close with the release your attorney approved and a dated signature. The app Emergent builds can capture that signature and saves each field to a database you own.

faq_plan.q: Can renters sign a boat rental waiver form before they arrive?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Renters can open the waiver link on any phone, a few days ahead or in the parking lot. The app can email a reminder the evening before to anyone who has not signed yet. A yoga waiver form follows the same timing, with new students signing before their first class.

faq_plan.q: Should every passenger sign a boat rental waiver form, or only the renter?
faq_plan.a: Either setup works on the form, and which one to use is a question for your attorney. The renter can sign for the group and list everyone aboard, or each adult can get the link and sign a copy of their own. The dock tablet then shows each passenger as Signed or Waiting.

faq_plan.q: How should a boat rental waiver form handle renters under 18?
faq_plan.a: Ask for a date of birth first and open a parent section for anyone under 18, signed in the parent's own name. If drivers must be older than passengers, add that rule to each boat's listing. Waivers for minors are limited in some states. Ask your attorney to review that section before the season starts.

faq_plan.q: What health questions belong on a boat rental waiver form?
faq_plan.a: Ask whether each person aboard can swim, and add a free-text note for anything the dock crew should know before launch. Keep the questions to what the crew can act on, and leave out medical history. A salon waiver form takes the same approach, asking about reactions to products instead of diagnoses.

faq_plan.q: Should a boat rental waiver form track life jackets?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Record how many people are going aboard so the dock crew hands out the right count. Under U.S. Coast Guard rules, each person aboard a recreational vessel needs a lifejacket the Coast Guard has approved. Add a size field for children so the crew picks jackets that fit.

faq_plan.q: Can a boat rental waiver form include a damage deposit?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Add a clause that states the deposit amount and what it covers, such as a bent propeller, and have the renter initial it. Collect the money through your booking or payment system. The app Emergent builds can connect to that system through its API and show the deposit status beside the waiver.

faq_plan.q: Can a boat rental waiver form show a renter's past rentals?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Each signed waiver is a record in a database you own, so staff can look up a returning renter and see earlier boats, dates, and damage notes.
